reference: User request: circular contact shadow beneath floating monsters; alpha sprite generated independently.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game sprite, soft circular ground contact shadow for a floating monster in a pale turquoise hand-painted Chinese underworld card game. Primary request: a SINGLE simple soft charcoal-grey shadow of a round footprint on the ground seen from a low camera, appearing as a horizontally wide, shallow ellipse. Exactly centered on a landscape 3:1 canvas; ellipse occupies about 90 percent of canvas width and 68 percent of canvas height. Very soft feathered translucent edges, slightly denser center; muted desaturated blue-black ink tone. Flat diffuse occlusion shadow only, no hard border, no ring, no object, no figure, no floor, no ground texture, no smoke, no light, no text, no checkerboard. GENUINE transparent alpha everywhere outside the shadow, naturally translucent pixels inside so the stone paving remains visible when composited. The sprite will be scaled UNIFORMLY as the monster floats; render the oval perspective into this bitmap rather than using transforms to flatten a circle.
